limitations: Machine-draft candidate series did not line up with the header columns for rows whose label cells span several grid columns; time mapping was rebuilt by hand (value cell index minus label columns).
Table 1 reports whole-tumor medians; the quartile row (Q1 Q3) is excluded because its two values are printed concatenated.
Dashes at t0 in the days and relative-change rows are excluded; the table footnote states they are zero at baseline. No time offsets are recorded as the printed headers are t labels only.
Supplement Table S2 (NAWM medians and percent changes) is recorded as typed supplemental facts, not as a series.
